figures.shows: Two panels seen from above: a camera looking north with three spheres around slices of its view, and the same camera turned 90 degrees with spheres of the same sizes
figures.caption: The turn moves the spheres around the camera but changes none of their sizes.
figures.alt: Two panels. Each shows a camera as a dot with a wedge for its view and three circles along the wedge's axis. The wedge points up in the first panel and right in the second, and the circles have the same sizes.

figures.shows: One cascade's square with an inner dashed square 33 texels inside, a point held inside it and a point in the band between the squares
figures.caption: A point in the band between the squares is shaded by the next cascade, so the filter never reads outside this one.
figures.alt: A large square with a dashed square inside it. One dot lies inside the dashed square and a second dot lies between the dashed square and the outer edge.

figures.shows: The Third-Person sample's Scene view down the course in the shadows debug view, at Medium and at High quality, with the legend's cascade rows
figures.caption: Both qualities color every surface green, so the legend shows the change. High adds a cascade nearest the camera, and the farther slices keep their far ends (5.8, 13.9, 32.7 and 80 m) with texels half as large, so their medians fall to about half.
figures.numbers: Read from the legends of the taken pictures (legend crops). Medium: C0 0.1-5.8 m, C1 5.2-13.9 m, C2 13.1-32.7 m, C3 30.8-80.0 m; texels 5.6 mm, 1.3 cm, 3.2 cm, 7.7 cm; medians 0.62, 0.81, 0.68, 0.57. High: C0 0.1-1.5 m, no receivers; C1 1.4-5.8 m, C2 5.3-13.9 m, C3 13.1-32.7 m, C4 30.8-80.0 m; texels 2.7 mm, 6.6 mm, 1.5 cm, 3.8 cm; medians 0.31, 0.40, 0.34, 0.28. The far ends 5.8, 13.9, 32.7 and 80 m are alike at both qualities.
figures.alt: A course of blocks, trees and fences seen from behind, every surface green, with white lines at cascade edges and hatched bands. The legend lists four cascades, C0 to C3, with medians between 0.57 and 0.81.

high.alt: The same view, every surface green. The legend lists five cascades. C0 covers 0.1 to 1.5 m and has no receivers, and the medians of the others lie between 0.28 and 0.40.

figures.shows: The shadows debug view of the Third Person course from above and behind, at the sun's cascade distribution of 0.9, with two cascade edges across it
figures.caption: The cascade edges at the sun's own distribution. The white line with the hatched band across the near platform is the 13.9 m edge, from cascade 1 to 2. The line on the far block's top is the 32.7 m edge, from cascade 2 to 3.
figures.numbers: Read from the taken picture's legend: C0 0.1-5.8 m with no receivers, C1 5.2-13.9 m, C2 13.1-32.7 m, C3 30.8-80.0 m. The line across the near platform has its hatched band on the camera's side, the C1 to C2 blend band 13.1-13.9 m, so it is the 13.9 m edge; the line on the far block's top is the next edge, C2 to C3 at 32.7 m (band 30.8-32.7 m). The camera stands 8 m above the ground, so C0 holds no receivers.
figures.alt: The start of a course of blocks seen from above, every surface green. A white line with a hatched band crosses the near platform, a second crosses the top of the block beyond, and the legend lists four cascades from 0.1 to 80 m.
